newsitem.title: USA: Price Enterprises sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Price Enterprises sets special dividend.

text.p: Price Enterprises Inc said its board of directors has approved a special stock dividend.
Shareholders of record on August 15, will receive one share of PriceSmart common stock on August 29 for every four shares of Price Enterprises held.
Price Enterprises announced a restructuring on July 2 that would separate its real estate and merchandising businesses into two separate publicly-held companies.
The real estate company, as a result of the restructuring, will be positioned to convert into a real estate investment trust.

PriceSmart will consist of certain merchandising businesses, real estate properties currently held for sale by Price Enterprises, notes receivable, cash, and generally, all assets and liabilities of Price Enterprises not associated with the real estate assets retained by Price Enterprises.
